reviews.title: Correcting review
reviews.comment:
Edit:
My stupid self totally forgot about the BIOS.
A quick BIOS update(and a mini anxiety attack during the process as a power failure or crash will brick the motherboard😰) and the CPU fired to life, giving my pc speed it never had before!
Very happy with the performance so far and now I can run my virtual machines, and Discord bot servers at the same time with next to no lag.
Highly recommend this processor if you're looking to build a nice budget pc, or upgrade from a slower  processor.
Original:

I'm going to clean it up, and put it back into the package.

reviews.title: AMD Ryzen 3 4100
reviews.comment: Excellent AMD Ryzen 3 4100 processor. It offers good performance for everyday tasks and light gaming, with efficient power consumption and stable performance. Ideal for budget-friendly systems looking for a good balance between price and performance. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Richard Taveras peña

reviews.title: Budget Friendly CPU Option
reviews.comment:
I picked this up for a cheap AM4 build when it was on discount. I wanted to build a system that would mainly be idle on the CPU so was trying to keep cost to a minimum and this fit the bill.
At it's regular price, there are much better options for only a few dollars more like the Ryzen 3600 or Ryzen 5500, but the nice thing with AM4 is the upgrade path is super easy and you have so many options
I have noticed that this processor runs a little warmer than some of the higher end 65w ones like the 5500 and 5600, but overall it serves it's purpose as a low end, lower power cpu that is needed to just run the system without seeing heavy processing load
reviews.author: Retro Mike Tech
